I: Intensity of the light on the plate
N: Number of fringe periods between the cursors
alpha: Direction the image beam actually leaves in
lambda_1: Wavelength the hologram was recorded with
lambda_2: Wavelength of the light that lights the developed plate
theta_i: Angle of the light that lights the developed plate
theta_o: Angle of the object beam from the plate's normal
theta_r: Angle of the reference beam from the plate's normal
x: Position across the plate (Δx: span between the cursors)
z: Distance from the plate along its normal
z_0: Distance of an object point from the plate when recorded
